abilities.name: Spawning Pool
abilities.text: If no Hive Spawn attacks this turn, at the end of the turn roll the 20-sided die for each Hive Spawn still standing, one at a time. On 16 or more, a destroyed Hive Spawn returns, unwounded, next to the one that rolled. A Hive Spawn on water or swamp needs only 12.

abilities.name: Mind Tether
abilities.text: Instead of attacking, Vothrek may seize the mind of an enemy Small or Medium figure next to it that is not unique. Roll the 20-sided die: on 15 or more that figure leaves its unit and fights for you.

abilities.name: Hive Command
abilities.text: Other friendly Aliens within 3 hexes of Vothrek roll 1 extra attack die.

abilities.name: Numbing Glare
abilities.text: When Ixaru attacks a Small or Medium figure, roll the 20-sided die first. On 14 or more the target rolls no defense dice against that attack.

abilities.name: Long Strides
abilities.text: Ixaru's strider wades through water and swamp: entering them costs no extra Move and does not end its move, and swamp never wounds it.

abilities.name: Tongue Lash
abilities.text: Instead of attacking, Gulpmaw may lash its tongue at a Small or Medium single-hex enemy 2 or 3 hexes away and in sight, and pull it into the free hex next to Gulpmaw nearest to where it stood.

abilities.name: Rubbery Hide
abilities.text: Attacks on Gulpmaw from 3 or more hexes away deal 1 less wound.

abilities.name: Lurk
abilities.text: When an enemy figure ends a move next to a Murk Stalker standing on water or swamp, that Stalker attacks it at once, whichever way it faces (each Stalker once a turn). Swamp never wounds a Murk Stalker.

abilities.name: Caustic Spores
abilities.text: A figure that takes at least one skull from a Spore Lobber's attack is poisoned: at the end of each of its unit's next two turns it rolls the d20, and on 1 to 7 it takes 1 wound.

abilities.name: Mending Ooze
abilities.text: At the end of Ulshae's turn, remove 1 wound from the most wounded friendly hero next to Ulshae, or from Ulshae.

abilities.name: Sticky Bile
abilities.text: A figure Ulshae wounds but does not destroy cannot move on its unit's next turn. It can still attack.

abilities.name: Swarm Bite
abilities.text: A Fen Leaper rolls 1 extra attack die when another Fen Leaper is next to the target.
